program:
PARAMS = {
    "Wp": (8.0, 3.0, 30.0),       # PMOS self-cascode bottom W
    "Lp": (10.0, 4.0, 20.0),      # PMOS bottom L
    "Wn": (4.0, 1.5, 20.0),       # NMOS (M1a) bottom W ; M2a = K*Wn
    "Ln": (10.0, 4.0, 20.0),      # NMOS bottom L
    "rscp": (60.0, 25.0, 150.0),  # PMOS self-cascode (W/L)top/(W/L)bot
    "rscn": (60.0, 20.0, 200.0),  # NMOS self-cascode ratio
    "R1": (360e3, 150e3, 900e3),  # beta-multiplier resistor: I = n UT lnK / R1
    "Rp": (1.48e6, 0.7e6, 3.0e6), # Ra||Rb  (PTAT gain)
    "kb": (0.55, 0.4, 0.7),       # VBE fraction = Rb/(Ra+Rb)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    K = 8
    Wp, Lp, Wn, Ln = p["Wp"], p["Lp"], p["Wn"], p["Ln"]
    Lt = 1.0
    Wpt = max(0.42, p["rscp"] * Wp / Lp * Lt)
    Wnt = max(0.42, p["rscn"] * Wn / Ln * Lt)
    R1, Rp, kb = p["R1"], p["Rp"], p["kb"]
    Ra = Rp / kb
    Rb = Rp / (1 - kb)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PMOS self-cascode mirror: M3 diode (on M2 branch), M4 -> M1, M5 -> Q3, M6 -> vref
    n.M("M3a", "p3", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M3b", "pg", "pg", "p3", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lt)
    n.M("M4a", "p4", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M4b", "ng", "pg", "p4", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lt)
    n.M("M5a", "p5", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M5b", "e3", "pg", "p5", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lt)
    n.M("M6a", "p6", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M6b", "vref", "pg", "p6", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lt)
    # NMOS beta-multiplier (weak inversion), self-cascoded
    n.M("M1b", "ng", "ng", "n1", "vss", "nfet", Wnt, Lt)
    n.M("M1a", "n1", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("M2b", "pg", "ng", "n2", "vss", "nfet", K * Wnt, Lt)
    n.M("M2a", "n2", "ng", "sr", "vss", "nfet", K * Wn, Ln)
    n.R("R1", "sr", "vss", R1)
    # output: fractional bandgap  vref = kb*VBE + I*(Ra||Rb)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.R("Ra", "e3", "vref", Ra)
    n.R("Rb", "vref", "vss", Rb)
    # start-up
    n.M("Mpu1", "s1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Mpu2", "s2", "vss", "s1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Mpu3", "x", "vss", "s2", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Msd", "x", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 10.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms1", "pg", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)

    # ---------- predictions ----------
    k_q = 8.617e-5
    T0 = 300.15
    Vg0, xti = 1.17, 3.0
    nsub = 1.35
    def veb(I, m, T):
        i_u = max(I / m, 1e-12)
        ut = k_q * T
        v0 = 0.76 + k_q * T0 * math.log(i_u / 10e-6)
        return Vg0 - (Vg0 - v0) * T / T0 - (xti - 1) * ut * math.log(T / T0)

    def outv(T):
        ut = k_q * T
        I = nsub * ut * math.log(K) / R1
        vr = 0.66
        for _ in range(30):
            ie = max(I - (veb(I, 1, T) - vr) / Ra, 1e-12)
            vb = veb(ie, 1, T)
            vr = (vb / Ra + I) / (1 / Ra + 1 / Rb)
        return vr, I

    v27, I0 = outv(T0)
    vs = [outv(t + 273.15)[0] for t in (-40, 0, 27, 70, 125)]
    tc = (max(vs) - min(vs)) / (v27 * 165) * 1e6

    i_su = 0.18e-6
    itot = 4 * I0 + i_su
    power = 1.8 * itot

    line = 0.03
    psrr = 40.0
    return n, {"vref": v27, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power,
               "line_reg": line, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}

events.topology: op-amp-less PTAT core (2:16 PNP, NMOS level-shift, PMOS mirror, long-L self-cascode devices) + fractional (Banba-like) bandgap output divider + weak-pullup start-up

events.reason: TC and line-reg failures come from self-cascode bottom devices sitting at the triode edge (Vds≈Vdsat, M2a in triode), so mirror and ΔVbe accuracy depend on supply. Raise top/bottom strength ratio to ~
The BJT ΔVBE core lacks headroom at 1.8 V. VBE + Vgs_n + Vsg_p(~1.08) > 1.8, which puts M2 in triode and collapses TC, line regulation and PSRR. Replace it with a MOS weak-inversion β-multiplier PTAT
